title: Keto Monsoon Ham Fry
description: A salty and flaky keto-friendly dish featuring Parma ham seasoned with classic monsoon Mexican (norteno) spices for a savory breakfast or snack.
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the Parma Ham and pat it dry with a paper towel.
Season both sides of the ham generously with Kosher Salt, Pepper, Garlic Powder, Cumin, Red Pepper Flakes, and Olive Oil.
Place the seasoned ham on a wire rack in a shallow baking dish to catch any drippings. Ensure there is at least 1/2 inch of space between each piece for even cooking.
Bake in the preheated oven for about 8-10 minutes or until crispy and golden brown.
Remove from the oven, let it cool slightly before serving.
